```{r}
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidyverse)
library(infer)
library(kableExtra)
library(openintro)
library(broom)

Movies_and_the_Bechdel_Test_movies <- read_csv("Movies and the Bechdel Test - movies (3).csv")
```

![Namesake Comic](https://s26162.pcdn.co/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/bechdeltestcartoon.jpeg)

# Data Wrangling

```{r}
cleaned_data <- Movies_and_the_Bechdel_Test_movies |>
   mutate(gross_income_2013 = rowSums(across(c(domgross_2013, intgross_2013)))) |>
  select(binary, clean_test, gross_income_2013) |>
  drop_na(gross_income_2013)
```

```{r}
cleaned_data |>
  group_by(binary, clean_test) |>
  summarize(mean = mean(gross_income_2013)) |>
  library(dplyr)


  mutate(test = case_when(
    clean_test == "ok" ~ "Not talking about men",
    clean_test == "dubious" ~ "Unsure of the conversations",
    clean_test == "men" ~ "Only talk about men",
    clean_test == "notalk" ~ "Not talking to each other",
    TRUE ~ clean_test
  ))

```

```{r}
ggplot(data = cleaned_data, aes(x = gross_income_2013,
                                )) +
  geom_density(aes(color = binary)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales ::comma) +
  labs(title = )
  theme_minimal() 
```

```{r}
cleaned_data |>
  group_by(clean_test) |>
  summarize(n = n(), mean = mean(gross_income_2013),
            sd = sd(gross_income_2013),
            min = min(gross_income_2013),
            max = max(gross_income_2013))
```

```{r}
aov(gross_income_2013 ~ clean_test, data = cleaned_data) |>
  tidy()
```

p-value = 0.000103

```{r}
obs_stat <- cleaned_data |>
  specify(gross_income_2013 ~ clean_test) |>
  calculate(stat = "F")
obs_stat
```

F-Statistic = 5.90

```{r}
set.seed(2346)
null_dist <- cleaned_data |>
specify(gross_income_2013 ~ clean_test) |>
hypothesize(null = "independence") |>
generate(reps = 1000, type = "permute") |>
calculate(stat = "F")
```

```{r}
null_dist |>
  visualise() +
  shade_p_value(obs_stat = obs_stat, direction = "greater")
```

```{r}
null_dist |> get_p_value(obs_stat = obs_stat, direction = "greater")
```

p-value = 0, therefore we reject our null hypothesis and accept our alternative hypothesis. The mean

### ANOVA Post-Hoc Test:

```{r}
test_results <- pairwise.t.test(x = cleaned_data$gross_income_2013,
                                g = cleaned_data$clean_test,
                                pool.sd = F, paired = F,
                                p.adjust.method = "bonferroni")
test_results
```
